sourceNotes: 菜单栏新增双行数值位置选择，可将数值放在上方或下方，并统一圆环、饼图、历史曲线等样式的文字排版
新增标准与灵敏两档占用着色灵敏度
修复辅助工具授权后的状态刷新与过期安装错误提示，并改善设置页说明的对齐
修复部分没有 Ftst 解锁键的机型无法重试接管风扇的问题
改善温度传感器首次读取失败后的恢复，限制网络响应与地址缓存大小，并为进程采集补齐超时保护
加固历史记录数据库迁移与读写异常处理，减少诊断日志暴露本机信息的风险

en: Add a choice of placing values above or below labels in two-line menu bar layouts, with consistent text placement beside rings, pies, and history charts.
Add standard and sensitive presets for utilization warning colors, with shared load levels across the menu bar, CPU/GPU details, and overview. Low-battery thresholds remain unchanged.
Fix helper status refresh after authorization and stale installation errors, and improve alignment of descriptions in settings.
Fix manual fan takeover retries on Macs without the Ftst unlock key, while retaining readback verification and safe recovery.
Improve recovery when temperature sensor discovery initially fails, bound network response and address-cache sizes, and add process-sampling timeouts.
Harden history database migration and read/write error handling, and reduce exposure of local information in diagnostic logs.
